seen_animation: a.png: Frames 1-3 show a closed book drawn on a diagonal, with a doubled spine line on its upper-left edge and short dash lines on the cover. A four-finger hand sits at the bottom edge, and a grey sheet of paper is behind it at top left. In frame 4 the hand has moved onto the lower right of the cover and the cover starts to lift: its top edge tilts up and extends to the right. In frame 5 the cover is raised and narrowed toward the spine, with the hand under it. In frame 6 the cover is edge-on along the spine, drawn as a thin sliver, with the hand on it. In frame 7 the cover has passed the spine and lies partly open on the left, drawn with broken dash fragments, and the hand is at left. In frames 8-9 the cover lies fully open on the left as a second page with dash text lines, and the hand moves off to the left edge and shrinks. In frame 10 only a small hook of the hand is left. Frames 10-16 hold the open book: two pages, a doubled spine down the middle and dash lines on both pages, with no further movement. The grey paper is gone from frame 8 on.
seen_film: d.png: Frames 1-3 show a black binder labelled 'Federal Reserve Regulations', closed, lying diagonally on a desk, with white paper at top left. A hand with red nails grips the lower-right edge of the cover. In frame 4 the hand starts lifting the cover at its right corner. In frames 5-6 the cover swings up and over to the left, blurred by motion, and the hand moves up and left with it. In frames 7-8 the cover has gone past vertical, the first pages show, and the hand is at top left letting the pages fall. Frames 9-16 show the binder open, with a fan of left-hand pages settling and slightly fluttering at top left and the right-hand page flat. The hand leaves at the top left around frame 9.
named_subject: A ring binder / book being opened by a hand: the cover is lifted and swung across the spine to lie open.
evidence: The order of events matches the film. The closed book with the hand at the lower right holds in e.png 1-4 (film 1-6). The cover lifts in e.png 5-8 (film 6-8). The cover goes edge-on in e.png 9-10 (film 9-10). It lies open in e.png 11-14 (film 11-14), and the open book holds in e.png 16-26 (film 15-26). The places in the frame also match: the spine is diagonal in the same spot, and the hand exits toward the upper left. The motion has these breaks: (1) e.png 4 to 5: the cover's top edge suddenly extends past the book's original right corner, so the cover becomes larger than the book under it, and a second outline of the lower pages appears behind it (a doubled cover). (2) e.png 5 to 6 to 7: the cover keeps changing length and outline from frame to frame instead of rotating one fixed shape about the spine. (3) e.png 10 to 11: the cover jumps from a thin edge-on sliver to a page that is already wide open on the left. The hand jumps about a third of the frame to the left in one frame and doubles in apparent size. (4) e.png 11-12: the new left page is drawn as scattered, disconnected dash fragments rather than an outlined page. In the film this page is a solid page continuous with the cover. (5) e.png 12 to 16: the hand shrinks frame by frame (12 large, 13 smaller, 14 smaller, 15 a fragment, 16 a single hook) instead of moving off the frame edge at a constant size. (6) e.png 4: the hand holds still at the bottom edge for frames 1-4, while in film 1-6 the hand slides along the cover edge. (7) From e.png 16 onward the animation is completely static, while film 13-26 still shows the left-hand page fan rising and settling. These are judged from still frames only, not playback.
primary_gap: The cover is not one fixed shape rotating about the spine: it grows past the book at e.png 5, changes outline through 6-10, and then jumps from edge-on to fully open between 10 and 11 while the hand leaps left and changes size.
closes_when: The cover is drawn with the same length and width as the book on every frame from e.png 4 to 13 and only foreshortens about the doubled spine line (closed, narrowing, edge-on, widening on the left). There is at least one in-between at e.png 10-11 where the cover is partly past vertical, and the hand stays the same size and moves a similar distance each frame until it leaves at the top-left edge.
protect: Keep the overall timing (closed hold 1-4, cover lift 5-10, open by 12-14, long open hold), the diagonal placement of the book and spine matching the film, the doubled spine line and short dash text lines taken from the doodle, the plain thin-line style without shading, and the finished open-book pose in e.png 16-26.
identity_gap: The open book reads as the doodle: two pages, a doubled spine line and short dash text lines in a sparse thin stroke. Two differences remain: the doodle's spine tail extending below the book is missing, and the left page in e.png 11-12 loses its outline and breaks into loose dashes the doodle never uses.
